The first call after the webhook is verified returns hmac_secret (signs triggers) and management_token (manages the job) — SHOWN ONCE, store them now; later calls say credentials: "already_issued". (REST: GET /v1/jobs/{id}/verification)

labels.name: retry_challenge
labels.description: Re-send a fresh url_verification challenge to your webhook (at most 5 re-sends (6 challenges in total), at least 60 s apart). The previous challenge stops working. (REST: POST /v1/jobs/{id}/verification/retry)

labels.name: list_jobs
labels.description: Status of every job you hold a management token for. There are no accounts, so pass each {job_id, management_token} pair (up to 20); a pair without management_token uses the Authorization header. (REST: GET /v1/jobs/{id} (once per job))

labels.name: get_job
labels.description: Settings, status, next_run_at, run_count and credential prefixes of one job (webhook path masked). (REST: GET /v1/jobs/{id})

labels.name: update_job
labels.description: Change a job in place: signature_in_body (true = triggers also carry cronjob_signature in the JSON body, for platforms that drop the X-Cronjob-* headers; applies from the next attempt sent) and/or max_runs. Raising max_runs on a job completed with max_runs_reached reactivates it (next run = next occ

labels.name: pause_job
labels.description: Stop triggering (idempotent). Schedule points while paused are not made up later. (REST: POST /v1/jobs/{id}/pause)

labels.name: resume_job
labels.description: Resume a paused or disabled job from its next schedule point; resets consecutive_failures. (REST: POST /v1/jobs/{id}/resume)

labels.name: delete_job
labels.description: Stop the job forever and revoke all its credentials. Cannot be undone. (REST: DELETE /v1/jobs/{id})

labels.name: get_deliveries
labels.description: Trigger log, newest first: scheduled_at, first attempt time, delay, attempts, status and last response code of each run. since/until (ISO 8601) filter scheduled_at; page with next_cursor. (REST: GET /v1/jobs/{id}/runs)

labels.name: get_run
labels.description: One run and each delivery attempt: sent_at, response status, duration, error and next retry. (REST: GET /v1/jobs/{id}/runs/{run_id})

labels.name: get_stats
labels.description: On-time rate, p50/p95 first-attempt delay and success rate over a window (default 24h). (REST: GET /v1/jobs/{id}/stats)

labels.name: rotate_secret
labels.description: New hmac_secret (SHOWN ONCE, store it now). Until previous.expires_at (grace_sec, default 24 h) triggers carry two v1= signatures, new first. (REST: POST /v1/jobs/{id}/rotate-secret)

labels.name: rotate_token
labels.description: New management_token (SHOWN ONCE, store it now). The old one stops working after grace_sec (default 0 = immediately). (REST: POST /v1/jobs/{id}/rotate-token)
